name: Text Type
description: Typewriter text that types, pauses and deletes one or more strings in a loop, with a gliding blinking cursor, optional typos, per-character reveal effects and select-style deleting.
contents: Wrapper element (configurable tag) with the typed text, optional colored prefix, and a screen-reader-only full text
Animated cursor element (character or bar, block, underscore shape) that glides to the caret
behavior: Types characters one by one at a speed, optionally randomized between min and max
After a pause, deletes by backspacing or by selecting then clearing, then moves to the next string
Cursor blinks with GSAP and glides smoothly to the caret position, following line wraps
Optional human-like typos that are typed then corrected
Optional per-character fade, blur or rise effect
Can start only when scrolled into view, and can type right to left
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by showing text without typing animation
editableByProps: Text strings, prefix and wrapper tag
Typing, deleting, pause and initial delay timing, variable speed, loop
Delete mode, type effect, typo frequency, reverse typing
Cursor visibility, shape, character, color, blink speed, glide, extra classes
Text colors per string and prefix color
Start on scroll into view, completion callback, extra props passed to the wrapper

needsCodeEdit.change: Add or change type effect animations
Change typo probability or pause before correction
needsCodeEdit.where: typo branch in the typing useEffect

fixed: Typo mistakes only apply to letters and digits listed in the keyboard neighbor map
Wrapper is inline-block with whitespace-pre-wrap, text wraps inside its parent width
Selection highlight in select delete mode uses a fixed 25% currentColor background
Unknown cursorStyle values fall back to the bar shape, unknown typeEffect means no effect
Text prop is required, an empty value renders nothing typed
Works at all screen sizes, no fixed widths or hover dependence
